author: The Infographics Show
description:
Being attractive makes dating easier. Keeping a relationship may be another story.

Research has found links between higher physical attractiveness and shorter relationships, with one possible reason being simple. Attractive people often have more potential alternatives. Dating apps make that problem much bigger.
They turn thousands of people into an endless stream of choices, creating decision fatigue and the constant feeling that someone better might be one swipe away. Looks also dominate first impressions online, while compatibility, personality, and deeper connection often get much less attention. Offline relationships can work differently. When people get to know each other before dating, physical attractiveness tends to matter less.

Having more options may help you get dates. It doesn’t necessarily help you find someone you want to keep.
